message: 乙女の舞いにてんてこ舞い

name: Synn
message: 「Really? Think I'll air out the futon. Come on, Paqy, wake up」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This week's curry rice. Did the flavor change a bit?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I tried a little trial and error. Kept me up pretty late last night because of it, though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「First you quit your part-time job, and now... are you planning to open a curry shop or something?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Slurp, slurp... Damn, this really hits the spot!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Your curry bento. Why don't you try making curry soba for a change?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh~, no thanks. Your soba is best eaten plain, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aw, you sure know how to make a girl happy! One extra tray of soba coming right up!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, that kick--delicious! Nothing beats wasabi in the morning~. Munch, munch, thanks for the meal!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll clean up, so go ahead and make your bento」
Slow-simmered curry. With this, my lunches for the week are secure.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. What happened after her dad started running that downtown casino?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, business was booming, and it looked like they'd even be able to cover Kirara's tuition」

name: Synn
message: 「Awesome! Now she's a lock for the music school she's been dreaming of」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nope. Right away, some nasty-looking rich guy set his sights on them」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He kept sabotaging their business, and things went downhill fast」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep. He had a moment of weakness and cheated. And he got caught……」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaah~~! Why'd he have to go and do that~~!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not all. The school found out Kirara was working there and revoked her recommendation」

name: Synn
message: 「She wasn't working, she was just helping out!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's an upper-class girls' school to begin with, you know. They're probably super strict about that stuff」

name: Synn
message: 「Sigh…… She's probably gonna end up pawning the oboe she loved so much……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, the Nishikata family decided to start over from scratch and left town. To be continued」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did you know? Apparently the actress who plays Kirara used to be a model」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh. So that's why she's so skinny」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Call it slender. She's so tall and doesn't have an ounce of extra fat. As another girl, I totally envy her.」

name: Synn
message: 「I kinda prefer someone a bit plumper~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oho~ So Synn likes glamorous girls, huh. You like 'em plump, bouncy, and super soft.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Getting all flustered is all the proof I need!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's the big idea doing that out of nowhere!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Touching someone's butt just to get back at me for teasing you!! No matter how much you like 'em plump, bouncy, and super soft--」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe I do, but I didn't do anything」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you, I didn't touch you!」

name: Synn
message: 「That thing must've bumped into your butt, Nanaka」
Out of desperation, Nanaka stretches the Demon's cheeks. What a terrible way to take her anger out.
「Thou shalt not lay a finger upon that creature!」
Startled, Nanaka tosses the Demon aside.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-is this girl... an acquaintance of yours, Synn?」

name: Shio
message: 「Be at ease. Now that I have arrived, there is no cause for worry」

name: Shio
message: 「Foul monster, I shall vanquish thee! Perish!」
Though Shio bravely swings her naginata, the Demon effortlessly dodges it.
Carried away by her own momentum, the supposed master assassin ends up smashing a wall to pieces.

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's gotten into this girl all of a sudden?」
A full-force strike swung down from high overhead.
The flash of her blade turns into a shockwave, sweeping up nearby public property as it surges forward.
However, the Demon simply tumbles out of the way and easily escapes harm.
Taking advantage of her flinch, the Demon body-slammed her. Shio-chan was sent flying dozens of meters.
Spinning round and round in midair as she was blown back, she landed on her feet. A cloud of dust kicked up.

name: Shio
message: 「What a blunder...! However, I am far from finished!」
The unbearable, pathetic spectacle only continued to escalate.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, aren't we going to stop her?」

name: Paqy
message: 「If we do that, we'll get caught in the crossfire, man.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, we can't just stand by and watch.」

name: Synn
message: 「And she just got blown away by her own ki.」

name: Shio
message: 「Tch, so this won't be straightforward, huh.」
The Demon had its giant mouth wide open, looking bored.

name: Synn
message: 「Got bored? Does it have zero sense of danger?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, looks like it was just messing around and teasing her.」

name: Misa
message: 「What on earth is all this commotion!? What are you doing in a place like this!」
Misa starts to rush over to Shio-chan, who is crouched on the ground.

name: Shio
message: 「It is dangerous to come closer, Sister!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, are you okay? Oh, look, you're already hurt! A handkerchief, a handkerchief」

name: Shio
message: 「That is why I said it was dangerous here...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold still. If we leave it like this, germs will get in, you know」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, you always push yourself too hard」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... is Shion-chan your little sister, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「We'll talk about that later. Please explain what's going on here」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, that little sister was fighting a Demon」
The Demon is crawling up Misa's leg, trying to slip inside her skirt.
Chasing after the Demon, Shion-chan loses her momentum and ends up burying her face in Misa's thighs as well.
Wait a second. Demons seem to like food, so--

name: Synn
message: 「C-C-Could it be! There's something delicious in there...!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You total moron! That's just plain perverted!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not just appetite--Demons are faithful to all their desires」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I-I know how to keep myself in check, okay!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I didn't ask about that! We have to hurry and save Misa!」
Misa herself firmly grabbed the Demon at her crotch and slammed it against the wall.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Looks like there's no need for us to step in」

name: Misa
message: 「My... my... I won't forgive you... Prepare yourself...」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't just stand there spacing out, we're fighting! Hurry!」

name: Shio
message: 「Ah, Sister!? Exposing your bare skin so brazenly out in public, how utterly shameless--!?」

name: Misa
message: 「C-Come on! Hurry up while they're covering their eyes!」
